provenance: User reports friend authored queries without seeing cards
limitations: Queries were inspected before changes: post-change results are regression evidence, not held-out performance.
Scope rules are lexical and incomplete; general intent understanding is not demonstrated.
No independent relevance labels or accuracy metric; no live LLM calls.

cases.query: my exams start in 3 weeks and i have no idea where to even start
cases.scope_message: Exam preparation and presentation coaching are not covered by this collection. You can choose a routine or study-break topic separately.

cases.query: can you make me a study timetable for the week? i have classes 9-3 and i’m free after that
cases.scope_message: This app offers short routine suggestions; it cannot build a personalized study timetable.

cases.query: i have 4 assignments due friday and i’m so overwhelmed
